description: Van Woustraat 32-36 (1882): 5.2-6 m shop-street fronts of a shop and three upper storeys of red-brown brick; three axes of white T-windows under flat, barely cambered brick heads with a small white keystone; white sills; iron wall anchors on the piers; a white plain frieze and cornice at 14.4 m; one white pediment dormer with a hoist beam standing up the roof over the middle axis

match.note: Van Woustraat 32-36 (1882), 5.2-5.9 m; cornice 14.3-14.4 m on the 2023-01-03 strip at a 2.44 m camera height, 3DBAG eaves 14.2-14.3 m

pediment-dormer.note: 32-36: one white dormer 1.8 m wide over the middle axis, 15.0-16.9 m, standing up the roof behind the cornice, pediment and hoist beam

door-left.note: a residential door at the left party wall beside the shop

rhythm.roofline: white frieze and cornice at 14.0 m, one pediment dormer with a hoist beam
schemaLimits: the heads' slight camber is flat
the dormer's low side cheeks are not drawn
